44/ /kong sprul ris med chos nga /zhe chen bstan gnyis dar rgyas gling nas spel/

༄7/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus/kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho(1813—1890)mchog ni rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu bya lor mdo khams 'bri zla zal mo sgang gi padma lha rtse'i mdun rol rong rgyab sbas pa'i ljongs su/ yab khyung rgyal grub rigs bstan 'dzin g.yung drung dang yum rnal 'byor ma bkra shis mtsho'i sras su sku bltams/ dgung lo lnga pa nas yi ge'i phyi mo soṭa gsan bsam mdzad/ dgung lo bcu skor nas ze chen 'gyur med mthu stobs rnam rgyal dang ta'i si tu padma nyin byed dbang po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po sogs ris med kyi bshes gnyen du ma las sgra tshad bzo gso sogs thun mong gi rig gnas dang /dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs mtshan nyid theg pa dang / bka' gter gsar rnying gi rgyud lung man ngag sogs sngags kyi theg pa bcas thun min rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la gsan bsam sgom 1

༄tsho/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /sgrub rgya chen mdzad/ skal ldan gyi gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i slad du/ thun mong rig gnas kyi lam nas bzung / thun min theg dgu'i mthar thug rdzogs chen a ti yo ga la thug gi bar du mdo sngags kyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag legs par ston pa shes bya kun la khyab pa'i mdzod dang /sgrub rgyud shing rta brgyad kyi smin grol gyi yang zab rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa gdams ngag rin po che'i mdzod dang / snga 'gyur bka' ma yang phur gshin gsum soṭa dang / gsar 'gyur mar rngog rgyud sde'i skor gyi sgrub dkyil smin grol phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa gdams ngag rin po che'i mdzod dang rnying ma'i zab mo gter gyi rgya mtsho yang zhun bcud du dril ba rin chen gter mdzod dang / rang nyid gyi zab gter gsang ba'i khyad nor thun mong ma yin pa'i mdzod/ de'i rjes 'brel bstod tshogs gtam tshogs gso 2

༄༅/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /rig sogs gsung rtsom thor bu'i rigs phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa rgya chen bka' yi mdzod bcas mdzod chen lnga zhes yongs su grags pa po ti dgung bcur longs pa rtsom sgrig mdzad// da dung mdo sngaṭa bka' gter gsar rnying ris su ma chad pa'i dbang khrid man ngag bklag lung sogs kyi 'chad spel sku tshe hril por mdzad de mthar dgung grangs gya bdun par gzugs sku'i bkod pa dbyings su bsdus so/ khong gi slob ma'i gtso bo karma pa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa dang bco lnga pa/ ta'i si tu bcu pa dang bcu gcig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i bka' brgyud pa'i bstan 'dzin rnams dang / 'jam dbyangs blo gter dbang po dang / chos rje kun dga' 'jam dbyangs soṭa sa ngor gyi bstan 'dzin rnams dang / mi tshom 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal/ gter ston las rab gling pa sogs snga 'gyur gyi bstan 'dzin rnams dang rgyud smad mkhan po ye shes gong 'phel/ brag 3

༄7/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /g.yab gdong sprul mkhas mchog ngag dbang dam chos rgya mtsho sogs ri bo dge ldan pa'i bstan 'dzin du ma ste/ mdor na skabs der dbus gtsang nas mdo khams stod smad bar gsum du khong gi zhal slob tu gyur pa shin tu mang bar snang ngo / /thub bstan nyi mas bris/

༄7ོ/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /༄༅/ /ris med chos kyi 'byung gnas mdo tsam smos pa blo gsal mgrin pa'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba bsdokyigs so//na mo buddha ya/ bskal bzang gi rnam 'dren stong rtsa gnyis las kyang thugs bskyed mdzad stobs khyad par du 'phags pa bdag cag gi ston pa shākya'i dbang po de nyid theg pa thun mong gi lugs ltar na dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas rang bzhin gnas rigs sad par mdzad/ bar du bskal chen grangs med sum cu so gsum la sogs pa bsod nams dang ye shes tshul khrims ti 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug gam bcu'i sgo nas tshogs bsags mthar phyin zhing rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs mthar thug par 'phel rgyas brtan cing / byang chub phyogs 5

༄༅/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'gyur /kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yongs su rdzogs te lam lnga mthar phyin te sa bcu rgyun gyi tha mar glo bur gyi dri ma shin tu phra ba'ang bcom nas gzhi bde gshegs snying po'i rang bzhin ci yin pa mngon tu mdzad nas/ chos thams cad kyi dbyings su mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas/ gdul bya dbang po tha ma'i don tu bka' dang po sdug bsngal kun 'byung lam 'gog pa'i bden pa bzhi lan gsum du bzlas te rnam pa bcu gnyis su bskor ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo/ dbang po 'bring gi don tu bka' bar pa gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi 'khor 'das kyi chos rang mtshan 'dzin pa thams cad mtshan nyid med pa gtan la phab pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo/ dbang po rab kyi don tu bka' tha ma kun brtaṭa gzhan dbang yongs grub ste mtshan nyid gsum gyis chos yod med dang stong mi stong legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ don dam du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 6

༄tsho/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /rdo rje'i sku dus gsum rgyun gyi 'khor lor rtag brtan chen por bzhugs pa nyid na'ang / blo dman gdul bya thun mong ba'i snang ngor zhi ba'i dbyings su snyoms par zhugs/ 'od srungs chen po sogs shā kyis bka' bsdu rim pa gsum mdzad/ bka' bsdu tha ma'i skabs nyan thos sde pa bco brgyad du gyes te grub mtha' bye brag tu smra ba dang mdo sde pa gnyis byung / de nas btsun pa chen po a bi tarka sogs slob dpon lnga brgya tsam byon nas sems tsam gyi grub mtha' tshugs/ de'i rjes su rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub byon nas/ 'khor lo dang po'i dgongs 'grel gtam tshogs/ bar ba'i dgongs 'grel rigs tshogs/ tha ma'i dgongs 'grel bstod tshogs gsum mdzad nas theg pa chen po'i bstan pa'i shing rta'i srol chen thog mar btsug de'i rjes 'brang sangs rgyas skyong gi luṭa la dbu ma thal 'gyur/ leṭa ldan 'byed 7

༄tsho/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /kyis dbu ma rang rgyud grub mtha' bkral/ zhi 'tsho sogs rang rgyud shar gsum dang / zla graṭa zhi lha soṭa kyis thal 'gyur riṭa pas lta ngan mtha' dag bcom pa'i rang stong grub mtha'i lam srol phyes/shing rta gnyis pa 'phaṭa pa thoṭa med zhabs 'jig rten du byon/dga' ldan du byon nas byams pa dngos la rgyan gnyis/ 'byed gnyis/ rgyud bla ma ste theg pa chen po sde lnga gsan te mi yul du spel/gcung dbyig gnyen dang tsand+ra go sī soṭa mkhas grub kyi slob dpon ches che ba du mas byams pa dang 'brel ba'i chos sde nyi shu bshad sgrub kyis gtan la phab nas/ phyir mi ldog pa gzhan stong seṅge'i sgra chen po bsgrags nas nges don dbu ma'i grub mtha' mkha' khyab tu brdal bar mdzad/ he ru ka dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis dngos su rjes su bzung ba'i dpal mda' bsnun zhabs dang / lū dril nag gsum soṭa grub pa'i slob dpon brgyad cu rtsa bzhi gtsos 8

༄7/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /pa'i rdo rje slob dpon ches che ba bgrang gis mi lang ba rnams kyis rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i gsang ba chen po'i mdzod rnams nas sngaṭa kyi rgyud du ma spyan drangs/ bskal ba mchog dang ldan pa'i tshom bu 'bum phrag mang po gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku grub par mdzad/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir thog mar rgya mtsho gcig tu 'khyil te ngan song gi gling du gyur ba la/ spyan ras gzigs dang /sgrol ma'i sprul pa spre'u dang brag srin mo gnyis kyis mi'i sa bon spel/ rim par mi'i gling du chaṭa shrīng phya dmu gtsug gsum bdud btsan ma sang soṭa kyis dbang byas pa'i mthar/ shākya li tsa bī'i rigs las byon pa'i rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po dkyu thag gis brgyud nas phebs te bod khams bdag tu bzung zhing / de'i rgyal brgyud las gnam la khri bdun/ chu la steng gnyis/ sa la legs drug bar la sde brgyad/ tshig la btsan lnga soṭa byung zhing / chab sring 9

༄tsho/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /bon dang / sgrung dang lde'u soṭa kyis bskyangs/ de ni bon snga dar te de'i lugs la zhang zhung sgro phug par gsum gyi mo mdud rigs gtso bo sum brgya drug cu/ mdud phran grangs med pas lha 'dre mi gsum gyi sgo nas gson gshin gyi skyid sdug lung ston pa phya gshen theg pa/ gtsug lag gab rtse sum brgya drug cu las gyes pa'i kun rdzob rtsis riṭa mi 'dra ba du ma yod pa 'phrul gshen theg pa/gnam sa bar gsum gshed dang gri 'dul chen mo'i bya bas gshin po'i bla dang / gson po'i gnas bde bar byed pa'i srid gshen theg pa/ gto thabs mi 'dra ba sum brgya drug cus yar la lha dang gshen mchod/ mar la byur dang sri mnan/ bar la phya dang g.yang blan pa snang gshen theg pa soṭa 'jig rten pa'i theg pa rnams dar bas bod kyi yul du grub mtha' la snga ba bon po yin pa'i gtan tshiṭa de nas byung / de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i 10

༄༅/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /sprul ba lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyis dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes/ spyan ras gziṭa dngos srong btsan sgam pos srol btod/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs khri srong lde'u btsan dang / phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa khri ral pa can gnyis kyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ o rgyan nas slob dpon chen po mtsho skyes rdo rje/ za hor nas mkhan chen rin po che bo dhi sa twa/ kha che'i yul nas dri med bshes gnyen te rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po gnyis dang / mkhan chen bcas mkhas grub chen po gsum gyis gtsor mdzad paṇa chen brgya rtsa phebs/ lo chen bee ro/ ska cog zhang gsum sogs sprul pa'i lo tsā ba du mas bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos 'phaṭa yul du bzhugs so cog graṭa che ba thams cad bsgyur/ 'phaṭa yul du thun mong gi snang ngor mi bzhuṭa pa'i gsang rgyud shin tu zab mo ji snyed pa'ang o rgyan chen po soṭa kyis mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod nas spyan drangs 11

༄tsho/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /te bod kyi bsod nams zhing du byon/ bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du slob dpon chen po bstin par mdzad pa'i rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga soṭa 'ja' lus rdo rje'ispre sku brnyes pa bgrang gis mi lang ba byung / gsang sngags snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa dang pa gnyaṭa la babs/ bar du gnubs la babs tha ma zur la babs zhes bden tshig gi rnga sgra ri yi khong na rlung ltar graṭa pa ste/de'ang snga 'gyur spyi la graṭa pa'i theg pa rim dgu spyi dang khyad par du rgyud sde tshoṭa chen 'dus pa/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ sgyu 'phrul zhi khro/ sgrub sde chen po bka' brgyad rnams la bshad sgrub rtsal du bton nas slob ma yang slob dang bcas pa 'bras bu phyi ma dang bar dor mi re bar zung 'jug gi sku sku tshe de nyid la mngon du mdzad pa sha stag yin cing / brgyud 'dzin gtso bo stod na sngags pa'i rgyal po so zur gnubs gsum/ smad na dam gtsang byams gsum slob 12

༄tsho/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /tshoṭa dang bcas pa/ rong zom chen po soṭa nas bzung da lta'i bar du bstan 'dzin gyi mkhas grub zam ma chad par byon/ o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pas gdul bya spyi dang / khyad par snyiṭa dus kyi 'gro ba rnams la dgongs te phyoṭa bzhi dbus lnga'i gter kha chen po rnams kyis gtsor byas pa'i ming can bye ba ming med grangs 'das sbas pa rnams rje 'bangs groṭa lnga gtsos o rgyan chen pos rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du smin par mdzad pa'i las can rnams kyi skye ba dngos dang sprul pa'i tshul du byon pa mchog gi sprul sku gsum/ gling pa bcu gcig dri med sde lnga/ nus ldan nyer gcig soṭa gter chen brgya rtsa/ gter phran stong rtsar graṭa pa rnams kyis chos nor rdzas sman gnas kyi gter kha soṭa gang la gang 'dul gyis 'gro ba'i don rgyal ba byams pa'i bstan pa ma shar gyi bar du mdzad pa de dag ni bstan pa snga dar gyi phyoṭa su gyur pa'i phyir gsang sngags rnying ma zhes 13

༄7/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /graṭa la/ da lta'i skabs su stod la rdor smin gnyis/ smad na kaḥdapa' / bar na zhe rdzoṭa soṭa rnying ma rang rkang gi grub mtha' 'dzin pa'ang mang la/ gteram̐zos rnams kyis ma khyab pa'i grub mtha' ni bod na gcig kyang cimed do/ /mnga' bdag khri ral gyi rjes su 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las luram̐ bstan pa log pa'i rgyal po glang dar gyis bstan pa bsnub cing dbus gtsang du mdo sngags gnyis ka ming med du gyur pa'i tshe mdo smad dan tig shel gyi phug par bzhuṭa pa'i smar g.yo gtsang gsum gyis bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal bsnyen par rdzoṭa shing / de'i sdom rgyun la smad 'dul zhes grags la/ da lta rnying ma dang dge lugs kyi sdom rgyun de yin/ mnga' bdag khri srong gis chos khrims bsdam pa'i tshe mkhan slob gnyis kyis dgongs bzhed ltar 'tshe ba chos su smra ba'i phyi bon phal mo che bsnubs 'ga' zhig mtha' la sprugs/ mo rtsis phyu g.yang sogs 14

༄0/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /sems can la phan byar gyur ba phal cher rang mal bzhag /dge bsnyen theg pa/ drang srong theg pa/ a dkar theg pa/ ye gshen theg pa/ khyad par theg pa ste 'jig rten las 'das pa'i theg pa lnga'i sgo bzhi mdzod lnga'i sgo nas mdo 'bum gzungs gsum gyis snying po'i don ston pa rnams rang sor bzhag pa la brten/ stod kyi bla ma che drug /bar gyi gdung rgyud bcu gsum/ smad kyi mkhas pa mi bzhi/ rig 'dzin lo paṇa gshen brgyad/ mthu chen mi dgu/ bon chen nyi shu/ rje blon stang gsum/ khyad par dran pa yab sras soṭa kyis don gnyis mdzad pa la bon rbar dar zer/ glang dar gyis bstan pa bsnubs rjes lha bla ma khu dbon gyis lo chen rin chen bzang po sogs khye'u nyer gcig rgya gar du brdzang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha gdan drangs/ lo paṇa de gnyis kyi bka' drin la brten nas mdo sngags kyi zab chos dpag med gsar du 'gyur/15

༄tsho/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /'di nas brtsams sngaṭa gsar ma phyi 'gyur du graṭa/ jo bo rje'i slob ma khu rngog 'brom gsum/ 'brom gyi slob ma pu to ba/ spyan snga ba/phu chung ba ste sku mched gsum du graṭa pa'i/ snga ma'i slob ma sangs rgyas 'od dpag med dngos glang ri thang pa rdo rje seng ge soṭa byang chub sems kyi mnga' bdag dgra bcom pa lta bu bzang la graṭa mang ba byon pa rnams kyis skyes bu gsum gyi lam ris gyis mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba sgrol bar mdzad/ de la bka' gdams pa zhes graṭa shing / sngar bde gsang gung gsum/ dga' skyo zul gsum soṭa gdan sa mang du yod kyang / da lta ni kar dge sa skya soṭa la chabs gcig 'dres pa ma gtoṭa 'brom chen po'i gdan sar sgreng soṭa la'ang grub mtha' rkang tshuṭa pa ni med do/ /dus de tsam na khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa dpal gyis bi kram la shi la'i paṇḍi ta kha che ba shākya shrī spyan drangs/ sa skya paṇa chen soṭa lhan gcig la mi bcu gcig 16

༄༅/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /bsnyen par rdzoṭa pa'i mkhan bu che byang chub dpal gyis tshoṭa dge ladun sgang / rdo rje dpal gyis snye mo tshal min/ de gnyis kyi mang na bu dbu mdzad bsod nams dang / dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis chos lung dang bye rdzing ste tshogs sde bzhi'i chos sde btab/ de nas brgyud pa la stong 'dul du graṭa te/ bka' brgyud pa dang sa su ba so/gas kyi sdeme rgyun phal mo che 'di'i lugs yin/ jo bo'i slob ma gsang phu'i gdarma/ sa 'debs pa po/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab dpon rngog lo chen blo ldan shes rab rgya gar shar nub tu lo nyer lnga bzhugs/ 'gran zla med pa'i ma/khas grub chen por gyur te/ de'i slob brgyud phya pa chos kyi seṅge zhes rig pa'i rtsal bla na med pas tshad ma bsdus ra'i srol thog mar btod cing / de'i rjes su gsang phu'i seng chan brgyad du graṭa pa soṭa kyis bstan pa la bya ba rlabs chen mdzad/ dgyes mdzad dngos byon mnga' bdag mar pa chos kyi 17

༄tsho/ /kong sprul ris med mosa'abyung /blo gros 'phaṭa yul du lan gsum byon/ yongs su graṭa pa'i paṇa chen nā ro pa/ mnga' bdag mi tri pa gtsos mkhas grub du ma bsten nas spyir gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi/ khyad par bka' bab chen po bzhi'i gdams pa'i bcud mtha' dag bzhes/ grub pa chen po'i go 'phang brnyes/ slob brgyud je bzang du 'gro ba dang / chos brgyud chu bo'i gzhung ltar ring ba'i lung bstan thob/ de'i slob ma ka chen bzhi sogs byon pa'i nang nas gzhung bshad chu bo'i rgyun lta bu'i bka' bab rngog ston chos sku rdo rje la brgyud pa rkang tshugs pa dus phyis bar byung / gtum mo'i bka' bab rje btsun mi las dka' spyad dpag med mdzad nas grub pa brnyes te/ slob ma grub rtags mngon du brnyes pa mtha' klas pa zhig byon pa'i gtso bo zla ba lta bu ras chung rdo rje grags pa zhes lcang lo can du sku lus ma spangs par gshegs pa de'i slob ma khyung tshang ras pa dang / rgyal ba lo sogs 18

༄7/ /kong sprularis med chos 'byung /brgyud/ phyis su ras chung nyid kyi sprul par graṭa pa gtsang spyon rus pa'i rgyan can soṭa kyis/ srol ka cher phyes pa'i ras chung snyan brgyud ces chos luṭa rkang tshugs pa dang / ngan rdzong ras pa byang chub rgyal po las kyang ngan rdzong snyan brgyud du graṭa pa mched cing /khyad par nyi ma lta bu mnyam med dwaṭa po zla 'od gzhon nu'am/ rgyal bas mdo yongs su grags pa gsum du lung bstan shin tu gsal ba'i dge slong 'tsho byed ces bye ba de la/ spyir dag pa'i 'khor lnga brgya/ ma dag pa'i 'khor lnga brgya soṭa 'byung ba sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa'i nang tshan sgom chen brgyad brgyar graṭa pa'i gtso bor gyur pa khams pa mi gsum gyis bka' brgyud rin po che dbu brnyes nas bzung mnyam med dwaṭa po bka' brgyud ces srid zhi'i khong na nyi zla ltar grags te/ de la'ang dbon sgom tshul khrims snying po nas bzung / dwags po'i gdan sa rabs dang rim par byon pa'i dwags 19

༄༅/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /po bka' brgyud rtsa ba yin la/ dbon sgom slob ma zhang g.yu drag pa brtson 'grus grags pa'i chos brgyud la tshal pa bka' brgyud graṭa shing / sngar dus tshal gung thang du chos srid gnyis ka bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phrin las can byung / khams pa dbu se'am dpal dus gsum mkhyen pa'i chos brgyud la karma bka' brgyud rim par byon/ sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig dngos khams pa rdo rje rgyal po'am dpal ldan phag mo grub las phag gru bka' brgyud rim par byon cing slob ma grub thob rnams las bka' brgyud chung brgyad du'ang gyes pa dang / 'ba' ram pa dar ma dbang phyug gi slob ma rim byon las 'ba' ram bka' brgyud du graṭa shing / grub thob khyad par can du ma dang / rgya nag gi bla mar phebs pa 'gro mgon ti shrī ras pa yang byon zhing nang chen du sngar dus sgom sde ri khag bco brgyad kyi chos srid shin tu rgyas pa'ang 'di'i chos brgyud laṭa 20

༄༅/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /te/ de bzhi ni bka' brgyud che bzhi zhes pa de yin/ de las kyang khyad par karma rka tshang ni rje dus mkhyen gyi sprul pa'i sku gnyis pa grub chen chos kyi bla ma zhes dpal sa ra ha dang spangs rtoṭa dbye ba rdul tsam yang med pa de nyid/ gdod ma'i dus nas rgyal ba rnams kyi phrin las par mgrin gcig tu dbang bskur te mtshan dpal karma pa zhes 'og min chen po'i zhing khams rgya mtsho thams cad la mngon par grags pa nyid/ slar gdul bya thun mong ba rnams kyi snang ngor mtshan gyi yi ges gsal bar mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan las dpal karma bka' brgyud zhes gangs can ljongs su yod do cog gi thub bstan khang bzang lta bu'i dbus na rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar mngon par mtho ba'i grub mtha' chen po 'di byung / de'ang spyan ras gziṭa dbang rgyal ba karma pa sku phreng bcu bzhi byon pa rnams kyi rnam thar 'phrin las ni rgya dkar nag /bod gangs can kun tu yongs 21

༄༅/ /kong sprul ris med chosa'abyung /su graṭa pa ltar la/ de nyid kyi slob ma'i tshul 'dzin kyang ngo bo'i cha nas spang rtoṭa yon tan rnam dbyer med pa 'od dpag med mgon rgyal ba zhwa dmar ba sku phreng bcu/ phyag na rdo rje rgyal tshab dpal 'byor don grub nas/ nor bu bzang po snga ma yan chad go shri sku phreng lnga/ rgyal ba byams pa kwa na ting tā'i si tu chos kyi spyan can drug dang padma'i ljags ldan drug /gzhan dpal ldan dpa' bo dang /tre'o rin po chen rim ste yab sras rnam pa lnga ni o rgyan chen po'i gter lung du ma nas lung gis zin tsam du ma zad mthong thos dran reg thams cad phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la sbyor ba'i bstod bsngags che brjod du ma mdzad/ lung gis zin kyang yon tan dang 'gro don med pa'i gang zag rang rgyud pa ma yin par mkhas pa'i tshul bstan pa rnams ni 'phags yul gyi shing rta chen po rnams dang rnam dbyer med pa grub pa'i tshul bstan pa rnams kyang lam rtaṭa phyogs rel 22

༄༅/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'gyur /grub par rlom pa ma yin par rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i go 'phang brnyes pa/ de'ang tshul mthong gi ngor mdzad tshul shas che chung tsam las don du mkhas la ji/ba cing sdo/ba la mkhas pa kho na las phyogs re ba ma yin pa de'i don gyis 'phrin las kyang rang rang so skye thun mong ba'i ngor yang dzam bu gling gi phyogs dang mtha' thams cad du 'gro don rtag khyab lhun grub tu mdzad pa 'di lags/ deng sang rje lnga pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngos slob mkha' 'gro'i snying tig gi grub thob rma se blo gros rin chen la bde mchog mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud nor bu skor gsum gyi bka' bab/ sangs rgyas zhig chen gyi ye shes kyi skus rjes su bzung nas tshoṭa gar chen po'i srol btod/zur mang gi gdan sa chen po btab pas zur mang bka' brgyud dang / rje dgu ba'i thuṭa sras zhwa dmar drug pa gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug gi slob ma kame chaṭa med de nyid gsar rnying dkyil 23

༄7ོ/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /'khor rab 'byams kyi bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi mthar phyin/ bskyed rdzogs la brtan pa chen po thob/ gter chen mang po'i chos bdag tu mnga' gsol thuṭa bskyed khyad par las dam chos kyi phrin las grub mtha' yongs la khyab pa de'i chos brgyud la gdan sa'i mtshan las gnas mdo bka' brgyud du graṭa te/ de gnyis ni rka tshang gi yan lag bka' rnying chu bo gcig 'dres kyi grub mtha' da lta'ang rang rkang tshugs pa bzhugs shing / gzhan yang yab sras de dag gi slob ma mtshar ba 'jam dbyangs chen po/ karma phrin las gnyis pa/zha lu lo tsā/ dwags ram pa/ rje dbon karma/ 'be lo tshe dbang kun khyab soṭa bshad pa gtso bor mdzad pa'i mkhas pa chen po rnams dang / gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum/ yang ri'i rtogs ldan brgyad cu/ rje ban sgar pa/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa grub chen/ e ba drungayig pa/ stag tshang yang dag /tsā ri rtoṭa ldan/ bam steng sprul 24

༄༅/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /sku soṭa mchog gi dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud pa'i grub thob ste/mkhas pa dang grub pa'i tshoṭa deng sang gi bar rgyun ma chad pas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad bzhin pa'o/ /gdan sa ni stod lung mtshur phu/ karma ri gling / bo gnas nang ste sku gsung thuṭa kyi 'khor lo gsum/ shar phyoṭa spungs ri dang / tre kai khyim yon tan gyi gnas/ 'bar ra dang grwa ma gru bzhi phrin las kyi gnas te/ de las gyes pa'i dgon sa/nas gtsug lag gis sa chen po'i khong thams cad khyab cing / deng sang ni bstan pa spyi snyiṭa ma'i skabs su song zhing gdan sa phal cher nyams gud du gyur mod/ kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas sku gong 'og gnyis kyi bka' drin la brten nas bstan pa'i me ro mdo khams nas bslang bas karma bka' brgyud kyi bshad sgrub gzhir bzhengs gsos shing / dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling nyid chu brgya'i mgo bor gyur to/ /mnyam med dwaṭa 25

༄༅/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /po'i slob ma gsal stong sho sgom grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur cingo / mi ma yin 'dul ba'i phrin las cano du lung bstan pa ltar 'gra dan mtha' yas pa bskyangs/ snga dus chas brgyud kyang kha shas byung la/ deng sang chos brgyud med cing gdung mi g.yel phug tu bzhuṭa par 'dug rje phag mo gru pa'am khams pa rdo rje rgyal pos dang po sa chen las chos gsan zhing / bod kyi luṭa kyi mkhas grub chen por gyur kyang rtoṭa pa'i ngo bo la thuṭa mches te/ mnyam med dwags po'i mdun du byon pas mjal ba tsam gyis chos nyid kyi bden pa gziṭa te slo ba ma brgyad brgya las gduṭa thogs lnga brgya soṭa byung ba'i gral nas mu chen 'ga' zhig gis gdan sa zur du bskyangs pa las/ bka' brgyud chung brgyad dam/ zung bzhi ya brgyad ces pa de byung ba yin cing / de'ang gdan sa chen po phag mo grur grub thob zam ma chad pa dang / hor dang rgya nag gi las ka 26

༄༅/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /chen po la dbang bsgyur ba'i sde srid kyang dus phyis par byung / de las gyes pa 'bri stag gnyis/ khro gling gnyis/ smar yel gnyis/g.yam shug gnyis zhes su graṭa pa'i dang po rten 'brel mthar phyin skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyis 'bri gung gdan sa btab/grub thob gnyos mgar chos gsum 'bri gung gling ba soṭa slob ma khri tsho bco brgyad 'dus par graṭa/ ri thams cad 'bri gung ri pa/thang thams cad 'bri gung thang par grags pa'i kha gtam du gleng ba'i dar rgyas byung / phyin su chos rgyal rin chen phun tshoṭa yab sras kyi sku ring nas gter kha gsar rnying gi ring srol yang dar bar gyur/gnyis pa mos gus mthar phyin stag lung thang pa bkra shis dpal ces pa des stag lung gi gdan sa btab cing / da lta'ang chos brgyud zam ma chad pa dang / sangs rgyas dbon gyis stag lung mar thang gi gdan sa mdzad cing / chos sku o rgyan mgon po soṭa skyes 27

༄tsho/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /mchog khyad par can mang du byon/ phyis mkhar drung mtsho skyes rngo rje'i sku ring nas bzung bka' dgongs phur gsum soṭa dang / rad gling soṭa sngaṭa rnying ma bka' gter gyi gzhung chen po yang tshuṭa pa yin no/ /gsum pa rgyal tsha kun ldan ras pas khro phu'i gdan sa btab/ de'i tsha bo khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa dpal gyis mi tra dzo ki dang / buddha shrī/ kha che paṇa chen gsum spyan drangs/ byams chen mthong grol chen po bzhengs/ dbon brgyud bzhi lnga'i mtshams kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che byon/ rgyud sde spyi dang khyad par yo ga la bshad sgrub rtsal du bton nas bu luṭa zhes pa'i chos brgyud khyad par can de byon/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i gsol zhal nang rten du yod pa'i gdan sa chaṭa pas zha lu ba zhes su graṭa pa'ang bshad/ bzhi pa rgya gar gyi chu bo gaṅgā tshun la rtoṭa pa mtho bar graṭa pa'i grub thob gling rje ras pa ni/ bzhugs sa'i mtshan la rna phu ras pa yang graṭa 28

༄༅/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /pa de'i slob ma grub thob gtsang pa rgya ras la bu slob bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dus pas 'khor 'gyed lan gsum mdzad pas bya rgod po'i nyin lam bco brgyad tshun chad dpal ldamyo/ 'brug pa'i bstan pas khyab par grags shing / de'ang dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pas lung bstan pa ltar/ 'brug ra lung gi gdan sa btab pas dpal ldan 'brug pa zhes pa'i mtshan snyan 'jig rten khams na rlung ltar graṭa shing / de'i bu chen gyi gral/ rje rgod tshang pa mgon po rdo rje las stong 'brug /rgyal ba lo ras ngar 4 ngabang byu sa ༄ dra/ smad 'brug /dbon brgyud las rgya ras seng ge dgu char du graṭa pa'i bar 'brug /'ba' ra rgyal mtshan bzang po las 'bar ra bka' brgyud/ rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis mon pa tsho bzhi grub rtaṭa kyis dbang du bsdus te chos srid kyis khyab pa lho 'brug soṭa byung ste/ mdor na mi phyed 'brug pa/ 'brug phyed sprang po/ sprang phyed 29

༄tsho/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'gyur /grub thob ces kha gtam du'ang graṭa pa byung / lnga pa smar pa grub thob shes rab seng ge'i slob brgyud las rgyal ba yang dgon ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rin chen gling pa/ spang mkhan chen 'od zer bla ma/'go mgon shing mgo ras pa sogs skyes chen khyad par can mang du byon zhing / phyis nas de'i chos brgyud stag bu bla ma rnams kyis bzung ba'i deng sang dpal yul ba la byin rlabs rgyun chu bo gcig 'dres su yod do/ /drug pa yel pa grub thob ye shes brtseṭa pa gang des lco ba'i phug /byang rta rna soṭa chags btab/ gling rje rnams kyis bla mar bkur zhing pha zog rten dang go mtshon tshang ma'ang phul ba da lta rta rna ru yod cing / sngar chos brgyud dar rgyas byung yang bar lam dus dbang gis chos luṭa rnyog pa can du gyur pa deng sang si tu padma nyin byed dbang bo'i bka' drin gyis byang rta rna rka tshang gi chos brgyud kha gtsang du bzhuṭa pa laṭa/ bdun pa zar ba skal ldan ye 30

༄tsho/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /shes seng ge'i chos brgyud grub thob dang g.ya' bzang sde srid du grags pa'i stobs 'byor can brgyud mar byung ba dang / brgyad pa mnyam med gyer sgom chen pos snyi phu shug gseb btab pa'i chos brgyud khyad par can/ phrin las kyang mtha' yas pa byung rung / deng sang chos brgyud rkang tshugs pa bzhuṭa pa ma thos laṭa/ de ltar dang po'i gyes gzhi grub thob brgyad ka'ang gong smos ltar bde gshegs phag mo gru pa'i slob ma kho na lags so/ /yang mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor du grags pa de nyid dang po bon la zhuṭa/ bar du rnying ma mdzad kyang chos kyis thuṭa ma tshims nas dgyeng lo lnga bcu'i steng na rgya gar du phebs te ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu ma dang / su kha sirnyi gtsos mkhas grub brgya dang lnga bcu'i thugs bcud rdzogs par bzhes te grub pa thob pa'i tshul 'phags yul gyi lū nag dril gsum dang mnyam/ bod kyi ljongs su snga 'gyur skabs rje 'bangs 31

༄tsho/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /nyer lnga dang / phyi 'gyur skabs 'di dang mnyam pa'i mkhas shing grub pa rdzu 'phrul phrin las thams cad la mnga' brnyes pa ni ma byon pa lta bu yin/ de'i slob ma rmog lcog pa dbon ston skyer sgang ba/gnyan ston/ sangs rgyas ston pa yan chad la shangs pa rin chen bdun brgyud ces skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sha stag byon zhing / mkhas grub rnam gsum khyung po tshul mgon gyi sku ring nas snyan brgyud rnams yi ger bkod cing /brgyud 'dzin rang rkang rmog lcog tu da lta'ang bzhugs/ chos brgyud ni kar dge sa skya jo zhal thams cad la 'dres pa dang / khyad par jo nang rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog la mkha' 'gro ni gus zhal gzigs te gdams pa gnang ba'i nye brgyud du'ang gyur la gdams pa 'di 'dzin pa'i skyes chen da lta'ang bzhugs bzhin pa la gsal/ de ni shangs ba bka' brgyud tshul mdor bsdus yin 32

༄༅/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /no/ / /sa skya pa ni 'jam dbyangs sprul pa g.yu ring nas g.ya' spang skyes yan chad lha'i gdung rabs lnga/ des khab kyi don du srin dang 'khon pas sras 'khon par skyes nas bzung 'khon gyi gdung zhes ming du chags shing / 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos gang sa thog mar btab cing de'i sras sa chen kun dga' snying pos la stod sa skya'i chos grwa mdzad pas sa skya pa zhes mtshan du graṭa/ mdo sngaṭa rgya mtsho lta bu mkhyen cing khyad par grub chen brnya pa'i gdam ngag lam 'bras bu'i skor thun mong ma yin pa'i bka' bab/ de'i sras rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs/ de'i gcung graṭa pa rgyal mtshan rdo rje slob dpon chen por gyur/ de'i tsha bo rje btsun sa skya paṇa chen dang / 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phaṭa pa gnyis ni bstan pa yongs rdzoṭa kyi bshes gnyen chen po ste rnam thar rgya bod kun la grags/ de lnga la gong ma rnam lnga 33

༄tsho/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /zer/ de'i dbon brgyud dpal ldan bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang /theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis te de bdun po la o rgyan chen pos lung bstan pa'i 'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud du grags shing / 'gro mgon chos 'phags la hor rgyal pos nub gcig gi dbang yon la bod chol kha gsum phul bas sde srid kyi stobs 'byor yang 'gran zla bral ba byung ba'i gdung rabs rim can da lta yang bzhugs bzhin pa lags/ sa skya dpal ldan bla ma'i slob brgyud tha dad du gyes pa las/ ngor gong tshar gsum phyis su byung ste/de'ang brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po'i slob ma kun dga' rnam rgyal dpal bzang pos gangs dkar rdo rje gdan dar rgyas su spel ba las gong dkar ba byung / shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi rtsa ba'i slob ma ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos ngor e waṃ chos ldan gyi gdan sa btab/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyis 34

༄7/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /phyug pa'i khri rabs rim par byon pa la ngor pa zhes graṭa/ spyir sngaṭa la mkhas pa kun dga' rnam gnyis/ mdo la mkhas pa g.yag rong rnam gnyis/ gnyis ka la mkhas pa go shāka rnam gnyis zhes su grags pa'i skyes chen de dag gi gsung srol 'dzin pa rnams las dpal sa ngor gyi ring lugs 'phel/ rdo ring kun spang pa chen po'i slob ma tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho'i gsung 'dzin mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dang / mang thos klu sgrub sogs kyi sku ring nas tshang pa zhes chos brgyud zur du byung zhing / rje bka' 'gyur ba dang gnas gsar ba sogs skyes chen khyad par can mang du byon la/ deng sang yang yar lung gi gdan sa 'dzin par bzhugs bzhin pa dang /rdzong chung pa las kyang lam 'bras tshogs bshad kyi srol ka zur du bye ba'i rdzong par grags pa yang byung ngo / /'phags yul gyi grub thob chen po lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'i thugs bcud rdzogs par longs nas 35

༄tsho/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /grub pa chen po'i sa la gshegs pa rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas bod du lan lngar phebs pa'i gnyis pa la zhang zhung gling kha ba dang /khro tshang bon po 'brug lha/ bzhi par me so rka gsum/ lnga par shar na dam pa phyag chen/ lho na rdo rje kro dha/ nub na dam pa phyar chung /byang na dam pa kun dga' zhes sgo bzhi'i rnal 'byor bzhir grags pa sogs rjes su bzung ba'i gdams ngag rnams kyi gtso bo/ dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed gnad/ rten 'brel gyi gdams pas 'gro don rgya cher mdzad pa'i rgyun la zhi byed snga phyi bar gsum du graṭa shing / ding ri kun spang chen po soṭa kyis gdams pa'i rgyun bzung bas deng sang gi bar du bzhugs so/ yang dam pa rgya gar gyis skyo ston sku mched la dam chos bdud kyi gcod yul gnang / skyo bsod nams bla mas ma gcig la gnang ba'i pho gcod dang / yum chen mo'i sprul pa ma gcig lab kyi sgron ma de nyid don dam du rdo rje 36

༄tsho/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /btsun mo rgyal ba thams cad skyed pa'i yum dngos yin kyang kun rdzob snang tshul tsam du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las rtogs pa 'khrungs shing grub pa thob pa'i tshul bstan te gcod yul gyi gdams pa rtsal 'don du spel bar mdzad pa ni mo gcod du grags la/ ma gcig gi rigs kyi sras rgyal ba don grub dang / thod smyon bsam 'grub/ chos kyi sras skye med dga' yan sogs sras po bzhi/sras mo bzhi/ rang dang mnyam pa brgyad du grags pa'i slob brgyud las 'gro don nam mkha' dang mnyam pa byung zhing / sha za'i phra man lcog la sgron 'dul ba'i ched du ma gcig nyid la 'dul rdo rje sgron mar sprul te zhu dag gi thebs su sbas pa'i gcod dpe rnams gter nas bzhes pa la gter gcod ces pa byung ba dang / phyis su rgyal thang bsam gtan 'od zer lam gcig dngos kyis gdams pa gnang bas gcod rgyal thang luṭa srol zur pa dang / drung pa ri pa 37

༄tsho/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /yab sras sogs bka' bab kyi brgyud pa mang du byon yang khyad par gyi bka' bab ni thams cad mkhyen pa rang byung zhabs la mnga' bas/ de nas brgyad pa'i gcod brgyud zur mang lugs srol da lta yang phyag len nyams bzhes dar rgyas su bzhugs pa 'di kho na byin rlabs lhag par che'o/ /gtsang nag rgyal gyi dben gnas jo mo nang du kun spang chen po thugs rje brtson 'grus/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho rnams kyis rim par rdo rje rnal 'byor gtso bor gyur pa'i mdo sngags bshad sgrub rgya cher mdzad/ de rjes kun mkhyen dol po shes rab rgyal mtshan gdan sar phebs te rdzogs ldan chos mchog gzhan stong dbu ma seng ge'i sgra chen po bsgrags/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi lam srol chen po phyis/slob ma'i thu bo nya dbon chos rje/ phyogs las rnam rgyal/ lo tsā rnam gnyis sogs kyis bstan pa'i sgron me sbar zhing / phyis su nag po 38

༄7ོ/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /sbyod pa'i yang srid rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog gi sprul pa'i sku tā ra nā tha zhes grub chen spyod 'chang dbang po nyid dang mkhas grub yon tan mnyam nges pa de byon nas nges don snying po spyi dang khyad par ba de dgyes gsang gsum dus kyi 'khor los gtsos pa'i gsang ba sngags kyi ring lugs nyin mo ltar gsal ba'i rgyun yang da lta'i bar bzhugs par 'dug ste jo nang gi tshul mdor bsdus pa'o/ /gzhan yang dbyangs can lha mos dngos su byin gyis brlabs ba'i mkhas pa chen po bo dong phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs dang / pa tshab lo tsā nyi ma grags kyi slob ma bka' bab bzhi las zhang thang sag pa sogs grub mtha'i rkang cung zad mi 'dra ba'i chos brgyud zur pa 'da' kha shas byung rung deng sang rgyun che ba mi bzhugs/ / /'jam dpal dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i shar tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dbal zhes mkhyen rtogs 39

༄༅/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid chen po des 'brog ri bo dge ldan rnam rgyal gling btab/ rgyal tshab rje nas bzung khri rabs rim par byon pa'i chos brgyud la ri bo dge ldan pa zhes grags/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen te khyad 'phags kyi thugs sras gnyis/ nang thugs kyi sras mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang / gdan sa chen po bzhi chags 'debs pa'i sras chen bzhi/ phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sras gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po sogs sras chen brgyad dang bzhi bcu rtsa bdun byon par grags pa'i nang tshan rje shes rab seng ges dpal ldan smad rgyud btab/ de'i slob ma rgyud chen dkon mchog don 'grub kyis rgyud stod zur du mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis kyis dpal ldan 'bras skrungs/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal pos se ra/rje dge 'dun grub kyis bkra shis lhun po'i chos sde btab/ dge 40

༄tsho/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /'dun grub kyi skye ba rgyal ba sku phreng rim byon dang / mkhas grub rje'i skye ba paṇa chen rim byon soṭa bstan 'dzin skyes chen rnams kyis da lta 'ang bstan pa spel bzhin pa dang / rngog lo khu dbon gyi skye bar graṭa pa bka' bcu grags pa rgyal mtshan skye ba brag g.yab sprul sku che chung dang / rje rin po che'i dngos slob shes rab bzang po'i gdan sa 'dzin pa'i chab mdo zhi 'phags kyi gdan sa'i dar rgyas rnam thar sogs ni yongs grags ltar ro/ /gzhan yang a tsa ra sogs mi gsum gyis gter gyi dbu brnyes/ sprul sku gshen chen klu dga'/ gyer mi nyi 'od/ rma ston srol 'dzin/ dbyil ston khyung rgod rtsal bzhi yis gzhung bsrang / rgyal rigs gshen/ rje'u rigs gru/ dbang ldan zhu/ mkhas pa rmelā grub thob spa tshang rnams kyis brgyud srol 'dzin pa bon phyi dar las gter rnying skor zhes zer zhing / blo ldan snying po/ mi shigs rdo rje/ sangs rgyas gling 41

༄tsho/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /pa/ kun grol grags pa rnam bzhi la phyis byon sprul sku rnam bzhi'i lugs zhes gter gsar gyi grangs su brtsi ste 'di rnams o rgyan chen po dang rje 'bangs rnams kyis sems can 'dul thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam rol chos la bon ming btaṭa pas lta spyod bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya bzhi po dang mi 'gal ba thar lam yod nges can du snang ste de dag kyang chos lugs grub mtha'i byung khungs rkang tshang phyir zhar byung du smos pa lags/ de ltar chos lugs de rnams kyi grub mtha'i dbang du byas na/ bod 'dir lta ba dbu ma spyod pa yod smra kho na las mi 'dra ba mang po spyod dbang med pa chos rgyal chen po'i bkas bcad pas bye mdo dang sems tsam gyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa bod du ma byung zhing / o rgyan chen po'i rjes 'brang kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer sog gsang sngags rnyingama'i mkhas grub rnams dang / mar mi dwags gsum nas bzung / phyis 42

༄7/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bshes gnyen kun gzigs chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi bar du byon pa'i bka' brgyu che bzhi chung brgyad kyi mkhas grub rnams dang / sa chen khu dbon/ rnams dang / zi lang paṇa chen/ bo dong pa/ khyad par kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas dol po pa chen po de'i dgongs pa gsal byed rje btsun chen po tā ra nā tha sogs jo nang bka' brgyud kyi skyes chen rim byon thams cad kyi lta grub ni gzhan stong dbu ma kho na yin la/ nang gses bzhed tshul gyi khyad par mi 'dra ba cung zad yod de/ rong ston shes bya kun rig /khra tshang ba blo mchog rdo rje/ rdo rje brag pa sogs dbu ma rang rgyud kyi lta ba 'dzin mkhan yang bag re byung ba ni/ zhi 'tsho'i rjes 'brang du mdon la/ kun mkhyen bu rin po che/ phyis kyis ngor tshar gsum/ rje mi bskyod zhabs/ 'byug pa pad dkar/rje rin po che'i rjes 'brang dge lugs pa thams cad kyis dbu ma 43

༄7/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /thal 'gyur gyi lta ba rtsal 'don du mdzad cing nang gses kyi khyad par thams cad la che ba re yod pa dang / rje rin po che dang 'jam dbyangs kyi bar du dbu ma pa dpa' bo rdo rjes lo tsā mdzad nas gsan pa'i dbu ma'i lta khrid dag ldan phyag chen du grags pa yang byung la/ de'ang rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ bso chos rgyan sogs dang / blo bzang don 'grub nas paṇa chen rim brgyud kyi dben pa snyan brgyud shes rab seṅge nas brgyud de phyis su byams pa'i mtshan can gyis 'dzin pa'i sras brgyud sogs rkang tshugs pa da lta yang yod la/ de bzhin du gzhan stong dbu ma'i lha khrid kyang thun mong ba nges don snyingapo'i mdo sde nyi shus dngos bstan gyi tshogs bshad dang / thun mongs ma yin pa byams chos kyi phyi ma'i man ngag gi don zab gsal dbyer med gdams pa'ang lo tsā ba zu btsan rnam gnyis nas bzung ste bar ma chad par byung ngo / /'di 44

༄༅/ /kong sprul ris med chos 'byung /'dra mkhas la mi dgos kyang / /byis blo 'brid pa'i me tog phreng / /bshad 'dod rnams kyi mgrin pa'i rgyan/ /blo gros skyed tshal grong nas 'phol/ /gzhan zer zlos nas 'chad pa la/ /blun po mgu yis mkhas rnams min/ /gzhung mang thos pa'i nor ldan na/ /tshig tshogs ngag gi gar stabs nyid/ /dam pa'i rnam thar bdud rtsi bzhin/ /rna bar zeṭa tsam lhung bas kyang / /gtan gyi dbul ba 'phrog pas na/ /dge bas thos grol nyid du shog /ces pa'ang skyabs mgon chen po'i zhabs 'degs pa mgron gnyer che chung sogs don gnyer snga phyi mang po'i ngor/ yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs yid dga' chos 'dzin du bris pa dge legs 'phel// //ces snga 'gyur rnying ma'i dgon chen drug gi ya gyal zhe chen bstan gnyis dar rgyas gling gi bla brang chen mo nas 'gro bron zhus/45
